comment: Live M01 discovery and finite-ammo proof. FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m01-recall-notice.json. Uses ordinary movement and trigger input; no granted equipment or teleports. One ammunition count per type, no reload.

states.name: disarmed_entry
states.note: Arrive disarmed beneath the annex canopy, facing confiscation.

states.name: alternating_punches
states.note: Alternating arms, no muzzle flash or tracer.

states.name: confiscated_tack
states.note: First recovered weapon, individually claimable by each participant.

states.name: tack_recoil
states.note: One acknowledged Tack shot spends one bullet.

states.name: tack_empty
states.note: All forty-nine remaining bullets spent through authoritative shots; a held empty trigger produces bounded feedback and no automatic weapon switch.

states.name: bay_bullets
states.note: A contested box of twenty bullets makes the pistol live again at once.

states.name: clerk_encounter
states.note: Finite Tack ammunition defeats the guard before the route split.

states.name: sweeper_encounter
states.note: Two bots approach around the records screen.

states.name: hall_flechette
states.note: Flechette recovery adds sixty bullets to the same count as the pistol.

states.name: records_supply
states.note: One contested box supplies twenty bullets at the balcony; the count depends on the fights above.
